name: member_risk
description: How likely this member is to leave after their next expiry, what they are worth, and where they rank on the call list.

name: why_at_risk
description: Plain-language reasons this member is at risk, the evidence behind them, and one suggested action.

name: call_list
description:
Calling a given share of members: expected churners, value at risk and expected profit for that whole share,
plus the first members to call. Use this for "what profit if we call X%" and "who do we call first".

share.description: Fraction of all members to call, e.g. 0.05 for 5%
share.title: Share

limit.description: How many of the first members to list
limit.title: Limit

save_rate.description: Share of called churners who stay, e.g. 0.2 for 1 in 5
save_rate.title: Save Rate

cost_per_call.description: Cost of one call, in the dataset's money units
cost_per_call.title: Cost Per Call

name: what_if
description:
Finds the BEST share of members to call for a save rate and cost per call, and the monthly profit at that best share
(from March 2017 results). Use call_list instead for the profit of a specific share.

save_rate.description: Share of called churners who stay, e.g. 0.2 for 1 in 5
save_rate.title: Save Rate

cost_per_call.description: Cost of one call, in the dataset's money units
cost_per_call.title: Cost Per Call
